component.name: Undertone
component.summary: Lyrics that live underneath your windows

description.p: Undertone turns your desktop into a lyrics lightbox whenever music plays. It sits on the desktop layer, above the wallpaper and below every window, so it is there when you glance at an empty desktop and out of the way while you work.
Time-synced lyrics scroll with the track, the album art fades in behind them, the colours come from the cover, and an audio-reactive visualizer moves to the beat.

ul.li: Works with any MPRIS player: Spotify, YouTube Music, VLC, Firefox and Chromium-based browsers
Synced lyrics from local .lrc files, LRCLIB and NetEase, with word-level karaoke
Rings, bars, wave and particle visualizers driven by the system audio with beat detection
Colour theming from the album cover, translations, multi-monitor layouts
Runtime control over D-Bus, listening stats, a shared listening web page

screenshot.caption: Synced lyrics over the album art with the ring visualizer

description.p: Beat-stable tempo, gliding lines, glass-free look, reactive glow, fonts, second accent, fades, profiles, pause screen, lyrics editor, hotkeys, panel applet.
